issue_context.title: schematelemetry: better redaction for invalid objects
issue_context.body:
We log found invalid objects here
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/c64b755ece7914767823aa18de42513716935fc6/pkg/sql/catalog/schematelemetry/schema_telemetry_job.go#L141-L151

In our live-streamed [logs](https://us5.datadoghq.com/logs?query=found%20invalid%20object%20with%20ID%20&agg_m=count&agg_m_source=base&agg_t=count&cols=host%2Cservice&event=AgAAAZBRnK0dlqQsvgAAAAAAAAAYAAAAAEFaQlJuSzBkQUFCM2R4a2o2bTRpNkFBRAAAACQAAAAAMDE5MDUxOWUtMmY2Ny00OTYxLThhYjktNzkyMTkzN2NmMTc5&fromUser=true&messageDisplay=inline&refresh_mode=sliding&storage=flex_tier&stream_sort=time%2Casc&viz=stream&from_ts=1719350201431&to_ts=1719955001431&live=true), most of the information we need is redacted; so, we end up having to grab a debug zip

There might a better way to redact the validationErr so we do not have to do the dance above

Jira issue: CRDB-39987

Epic CRDB-39822

review_comments: lgtm! do we have any testing for this?
